title: Excursion boats and why he stayed home
summary: He never played the boats, preferring day trips because he disliked being away from home.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: And what were you going to say about the boats?
Well, I said we had the boats, too. The fellas used to play on the boats. They would make different trips. Yeah, but it was a different group, you know, different playing.
You didn't ever play on the boats?

Nope, I never had played on the boats. I remember Captain Cool and so forth like that. Several boys that played with him. But I wasn't too much on traveling. I would go in one day and come back. I wasn't the only one to stay away too long. I've had the opportunity to stay away, but I didn't want to stay away. Yeah, I always did like home. But if I would have left, when I should have left, what I know, everybody that wanted me, I would have made what I wanted to make. But by staying, well, I was a homely fellow. Didn't want to leave home.
